HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT
JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 595/2023 Harish S/o Shri Nenu Ram, Aged About 22 Years, B/c Jat R/o Vill.

sentences.text:
Pabusar Ps Panchodi Dist. Nagaur (At Present Lodged In Dist. Jail Nagaur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr.Sunil Kumar Mehta.
For Respondent-State : Mr.Shiv Kumar Bhati, P.P.
For Complainant : Mr.Sunil Bishnoi.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR  ORDER 19/04/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.69/2022 registered at the Police Station Panchodi,
District Nagaur, for offences under Sections 498A, 304B and 201 IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the marriage of the petitioner and deceased was solemnized in the year 2020.
The petitioner is a Police Constable, serving the Police Department since 2018.

Learned counsel submitted that in the FIR and statement of the complainant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., omnibus allegations of demand for dowry have been levelled against the present petitioner and co-accused.

Learned counsel submitted that the co-accused Nenu Ram and Khemi Devi (father and mother of the petitioner) have already been enlarged on bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court in S.B.Cr.Misc. Bail Application No.12372/2022 decided on 23.9.2022.

The case of the [2023/RJJD/010941] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-595/2023] petitioner is not Harish vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/010941) on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161663603/
1 distinguishable with that of the co-accused, who have already been enlarged on bail.
Lastly it was submitted that prima-facie, there is nothing on record to suggest that the conduct of the petitioner was such which would drive the deceased to commit the suicide.
Learned counsel implored the Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposed the bail application.
Heard.

Considering the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner-Harish S/o Shri Nenu Ram shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.69/2022 registered at the Police Station Panchodi, District Nagaur, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
( KULDEEP MATHUR),J /tarun goyal/ Sr.No.27 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
